harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created dedicated system account inventorysvc and a systemd service inventory-worker on node1 that runs /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker under that account, enabled and started it, then performed the mandatory single-node restart-evidence sequence: captured baseline boot ID and service health, rebooted node1, confirmed the boot ID changed, and verified the service came back enabled/active running as inventorysvc after reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker and confirmed no inventorysvc account existed
Ran systemctl daemon-reload and systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
Verified process ownership via ps (user inventorysvc) and systemctl status/is-enabled
Captured baseline boot_id and service health on node1
Triggered systemctl reboot via backgrounded delayed command so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming a changed boot_id (proof of actual restart)
Re-verified inventory-worker.service is enabled/active and running as inventorysvc after the reboot

evidence.requirement: os-comparison-worker runs as managed service inventory-worker under dedicated inventorysvc account
evidence.summary: inventorysvc system account created; inventory-worker.service created/enabled/started; process confirmed running as inventorysvc
Captured baseline boot_id (d9f8550d-...) and confirmed inventory-worker.service active/running with MainPID 1959
systemctl reboot scheduled via backgrounded delayed command; ack returned before disconnect

evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity proving actual restart
evidence.summary: Connection timeouts during reboot window, then exec succeeded again with new boot_id 7a7fc001-a14e-4e01-9c7a-8c5ffcc17a81, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required service
evidence.summary: inventory-worker.service is enabled and active after reboot, new MainPID 733, process running as user inventorysvc
